pages.description: The Book Covers are  at the core of the  spellbinder. They  allow to give your  binder special  properties and  effects, similar to  how Armor Threads  work. You can use an  Alteration Table to  slot up to two covers  into the Spell  Binder.

pages.title: Book Cover : Cheap Damage
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will greatly discount the spells cast from the equipped book but heavily reduce their damage.

pages.title: Book Cover : Slow Power
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the damage of the spells cast from the equipped book but heavily reduce their speed.

pages.title: Book Cover : Sharp Pages
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the melee damage of the spellbinder if used as a weapon.

pages.title: Book Cover : Heavy Cover
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will increase the knockback of the spellbinder if used as a melee weapon.

pages.title: Book Cover : Wheel of Fortune
pages.description: Thread for the spellbinder. Will randomly add positive augments to effects of your spells when equipped.
